title: Ananda Says Yes! Keizan's Denkoroku, talk3
speaker: Nomon Tim Burnett
summary: Nomon Tim Burnett takes up the third story in Keizan's Denkoroku, the case of Ananda and Kasyapa, in which Ananda asks what was transmitted beyond the gold brocade robe. Kasyapa calls "Ananda," Ananda answers "Yes," and Kasyapa tells Ananda to topple the flagpole in front of the gate. Nomon first describes the women patrons who supported Keizan, then Ananda's long yearning and his tears before the first council. Nomon recalls working with this "Yes" for years with Norman Fischer, until a flagpole clinking at Samish Island and Norman's sudden "Tim" in dokusan. The evening closes on a silent sit with the question "When do you listen?"
